methods_quotes.q: National and regional percentages of patient visits for ILI are weighted on the basis of state population.
The national baseline was calculated as the mean percentage of patient visits for ILI during noninfluenza weeks
The epidemic threshold is 1.645 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline.
The seasonal baseline is projected using a robust regression procedure that applies a periodic regression model
